skill.name: enrich-company-domains
skill.description: Enriches a list of company domains with firmographics from Leadsets enrich_company: industry, headcount band, location and technology stack, each with its source and last-checked date. Dedupes and normalizes domains, plans the run against remaining limits and reports domains it could not match. Use when someone says "enrich these domains", "add industry and size to my account list" or "fill in company data for this CSV".
skill.summary: Add company details to domain lists with Leadsets and flag unmatched rows and conflicting values.
skill.author: leadsets

security_audit.summary: Of 19 static flags, only the Leadsets endpoint represents a real risk: the workflow sends submitted company domains to an external provider. The workflow can consume enrichment credits and write to connected records without explicit confirmation steps. No evidence found of shell execution, system reconnaissance, or prompt injection.

remediation.issue: Company domain lists are sent to an external provider.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose Leadsets as the recipient before the first lookup. Send only approved, normalized company domains. Exclude private hostnames and unrelated spreadsheet or CRM fields.

remediation.issue: The workflow can use metered records without a user-approved cap.
remediation.suggestion: Show the maximum record cost, including probes, and obtain approval before enrichment. Enforce that cap across retries and resumed batches.

remediation.issue: Connected spreadsheets and CRM records can be changed without a preview.
remediation.suggestion: Show the destination, affected records, and proposed changes before write-back. Require confirmation and keep a CSV preview as the default.

content.value_statement: A list of websites alone does not show which companies fit your criteria. Add company details from Leadsets and see which rows need review.
actual_capabilities: Normalize website URLs into company domains and look up duplicate domains only once.
Check available Leadsets records, test one domain, and plan batches around account limits.
Add industry, headcount band, location, and technology stack with source and checked dates when available.
Map results to the original row order and report unmatched domains, skipped inputs, and conflicts.
Export results to CSV or write to Google Sheets or Attio through a connected account.
limitations: Lookups require a Leadsets account and an MCP connection or REST API key.
Leadsets may not match a domain or may have incomplete or outdated company details.
Successful matches use enrichment records. Unmatched requests still count toward request limits.
This workflow does not find contacts, verify email addresses, or scrape company websites.

use_cases.title: Segment a List of Target Accounts
use_cases.description: Add industry and company size to existing account rows so teams can review accounts against their sales criteria.

use_cases.title: Review Companies From an Event
use_cases.description: Add company locations to event account lists and separate unmatched websites for manual review.

use_cases.title: Fill Gaps in Company Records
use_cases.description: Find missing company details in Attio and review differences before approving updates to empty fields.

prompt_templates.title: Look Up One Company
prompt_templates.prompt: Look up the industry and headcount band for this approved company domain in Leadsets. Include the source and checked date.

prompt_templates.title: Enrich a CSV
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Website column in this approved CSV. Add industry and location in the original row order. List skipped and unmatched rows separately.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Quota-Limited Run
prompt_templates.prompt: Normalize and deduplicate the domains in this sheet. Check available Leadsets records and show a batch plan. Wait for approval before any enrichment.

prompt_templates.title: Preview an Attio Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Enrich these approved Attio company domains with industry and technology stack. Prepare changes for empty fields only. List conflicts and wait for approval before write-back.

output_examples.input: Add industry and headcount band to an approved CSV with 12 company website rows.
output: The 12 input rows contained 10 unique domains, one duplicate row, and one invalid website.
Leadsets matched eight domains and used eight enrichment records. Two domains had no match.
The CSV preserves the original order and includes the source and checked date for matched details.

output_examples.input: Review industry and location for three approved Attio company records before writing changes.
output: Two records have missing locations that can be filled. One existing industry value differs from the Leadsets result.
No Attio records changed. The proposed updates and the industry conflict are ready for review.

best_practices: Approve which domains can be sent to Leadsets and set a record limit before the first lookup.
Check the sample match and checked dates before using the results for account decisions.
Preview proposed changes in a CSV before allowing writes to a shared sheet or CRM.
anti_patterns: Sending private hostnames or unrelated spreadsheet columns as lookup data.
Treating an unmatched domain as proof that a company does not exist.
Replacing existing company values without reviewing conflicts and approving the updates.

faq.question: Can I use full website URLs?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow removes protocols, paths, query strings, and a leading www before deduplicating domains.

faq.question: Which details can Leadsets add?
faq.answer: The default fields are industry, headcount band, location, and technology stack. Results include source and checked date when available.

faq.question: Are my domains sent outside my workspace?
faq.answer: Yes. Lookups send normalized company domains to Leadsets. Submit only domains that your organization permits you to share.

faq.question: What happens if a domain has no match?
faq.answer: It is marked as unmatched without a guessed value. The lookup uses no enrichment record but still counts as a request.

faq.question: Will this replace my existing data?
faq.answer: By default, it fills empty fields and reports conflicts. Request a preview before allowing writes to a connected sheet or CRM.

faq.question: Can I get employee names or email addresses?
faq.answer: No. This workflow returns company details only and does not perform contact discovery or email verification.
